lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents in 2026 (DOSM mid-year estimate) per km² of the district that covers most of the hex, measured on the district boundary. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Population change
lenses.description: Population change from 2021 to 2026 (DOSM mid-year estimates) in the district that covers most of the hex. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Non-citizens
lenses.description: Non-citizens ÷ all residents of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM estimate). DOSM's district table does not break non-citizens down by ethnic group, so they are shown here rather than in the Ethnicity lenses.
lenses.note: Share of all residents, not a head count.

lenses.name: Malay
lenses.description: Malay citizens ÷ all citizens of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM mid-year estimate, by DOSM's ethnic groups). Every ethnicity lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of citizens (2026), not a head count; non-citizens are in their own lens.

lenses.name: Other Bumiputera
lenses.description: Other Bumiputera citizens ÷ all citizens of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM mid-year estimate, by DOSM's ethnic groups). DOSM counts the many indigenous peoples of Sabah and Sarawak (among them the Iban, Kadazan-Dusun, Bidayuh, Bajau and Melanau) and the Orang Asli of the peninsula together as Other Bumiputera. Every ethnicity lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of citizens (2026), not a head count; non-citizens are in their own lens.

lenses.name: Islam
lenses.description: Residents recorded under Islam ÷ all residents, citizens and non-citizens, of the district that covers most of the hex (2020 Population and Housing Census). Every religion lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of all residents (2020 Census), not a head count; one figure per district.
